title.suggested: An Example for Tom Allen: Ben Hogan turns evangelist

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reprinted a Spokane Review item, headed "An Example for Tom Allen," on Ben Hogan, a former gambler and prize fighter who had once fought men like Allen for the championship of America, now preaching as an evangelist.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Thursday, November 27, 1890, page 4. Item credited to the Spokane Review.

facts.fact: Ben Hogan, later an evangelist, had once measured muscle and science with Tom Allen for the championship of America

notes: Needs a wider crop: the right side of the column is missing, so the exact wording around Allen ('...measured muscle and science [...] such men as Tom Allen for the [champi]onship of America') cannot be confirmed. Facts-index has an undated note about a planned Allen-Hogan fight (id 000).
